# manifold_governance_policy (Data Source)

Reads one governance policy, including the Cedar rule behind it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "manifold_governance_policy" "example" {
  id = "3f0b8c1e-5d2a-4c7e-9b1f-2a6d8e4c0f17"
}

output "rule" {
  value = data.manifold_governance_policy.example.cedar_policy
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The policy's identifier, a UUID.

### Read-Only

- `action` (String) What the policy does on a match: `alert`, `advise`, `correct`, `ask`, `block` or `block_session`.
- `action_options` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action_options))
- `category` (String) One of `ACCESS`, `EXECUTION`, `DATA`, `USAGE`.
- `cedar_policy` (String) The Cedar expression the policy is evaluated from. Null for managed policies that keep it internal.
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) What the policy detects and why it matters.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy is evaluated at all.
- `is_managed` (Boolean) True for a Manifold-maintained policy, which cannot be edited or deleted.
- `owner` (String) Who maintains the policy.
- `priority` (Number) Attribution order when several blocking policies match one event; the highest supplies the block message.
- `response_message` (String) What the agent is told when the policy blocks, or the directive an `advise`/`correct` policy hands the model. Null when unset.
- `severity` (String) Severity carried by the violations this policy produces.
- `taxonomy_mappings` (List of String) Framework codes the policy maps to, e.g. `OWASP-ASI02`.
- `title` (String)
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the last change.

<a id="nestedatt--action_options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action_options`

Read-Only:

- `notify_user` (Boolean) Whether the developer is notified when the policy matches.
